clean_body: Donate directly to these battleground Democrats.| | | | = Friends, we have less than a week to go until Election Day and I’m reaching out with one final ask to support Democratic candidates who are facing very tough fights. I’m proud to be a co-chair of the DCCC’s Red Alert program that helps supporters identify the races most in need of help — and this is what it all comes down to. We are so close to securing the blue wave election the American people have been working for, but we can’t let up yet. = DCCC Red Alert Round #4 Frontline Members: Rep. Adam Gray (CA-13) Rep. Kathy Castor (FL-14) Rep. Don Davis (NC-01) Red to Blue Candidates: Leela Gray (FL-13) Eliott Rodriguez (FL-27) Jake Johnson (MN-01) Teresa Benitez-Thompson (NV-02) Bob Harvie (PA-01) Nancy Lacore (SC-01) Mitchell Berman (WI-01) Republicans know that Frontline Members Adam Gray (CA-13) , Kathy Castor (FL-14) and Don Davis (NC-01) are popular with their constituents and hard to beat at the ballot box, so Donald Trump and Republican super PACs are spending millions of dollars against them in the final days of the election. These battle-tested incumbents need resources to continue fighting back and communicating with undecided voters in their districts. Retired Army Brigadier General Leela Gray (FL-13) (who I just had the pleasure of campaigning with in Florida!) has dedicated her life to serving her country and is running for Congress to bring that same commitment to Florida families. A third-generation veteran, Leela served 30 years in uniform before earning her law degree to help fellow veterans access the benefits they earned. A mother, attorney, and longtime Tampa Bay resident, Leela has always put service over self and plans to do the same in Congress. Eliott Rodriguez (FL-27) is a trusted voice and beloved member of the Miami-Dade community. For 25 years, Miami-Dade residents invited him into their homes as an anchor for CBS Miami, and trusted him to deliver news about their friends, families, and neighbors. The son of Cuban immigrants, Rodriguez knows what South Florida is going through, not just because he covered it for decades, but because he’s lived it. Jake Johnson (MN-01) is the son of a garbage collector and a meter reader who grew up with ten siblings in a family that worked hard to achieve the American dream while relying on Medicaid and SNAP. Now a public school math teacher and leader in his union, Jake is running for Congress because Southern Minnesota is struggling and MAGA extremist Brad Finstad is making things worse. Teresa Benitez-Thompson (NV-02) is a mom, community advocate, and the former Majority Leader of the Nevada Assembly. She has put this seat on the map and is leading her MAGA extremist opponent in the polls. GOTV efforts could make all the difference in this race, and Teresa just needs the resources to continue communicating with voters in the home stretch. Bob Harvie (PA-01) has Republicans running scared because the polls show this race is in a dead heat. Bob is a former public school teacher and community leader who needs your support to get his message out to voters before Election Day. Nancy Lacore (SC-01) served our nation for 35 years in the Navy, a career that she began as a helicopter pilot and culminated in her service as a three-star admiral and the Chief of the Navy Reserve, overseeing more than 60,000 sailors. Nancy can win, but only if she has the resources to communicate with South Carolinians and get out the vote. Mitchell Berman (WI-01) is uniquely positioned to flip this district in November. As an ER nurse who has seen firsthand how patients struggle to get care because of Republican policies, Mitch is committed to standing up to corruption and special interests in Washington. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and will be split between the 10 DCCC Red Alert candidates listed above: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you so much for your support. I was recently reminded of the powerful influences that are working behind the scenes to undermine the foundation of our Country. I recently drafted a series of letters to the editor for members of Patriots for Jesus to consider submitting. The letters were intended to encourage voters to reflect on their Christian faith and values when making their choices in the upcoming election.
I had found some great letters written by other patriotic Christians and I prompted one of the popular artificial intelligence platforms to help draft letters that "focus on the Christian and biblical principles" similar to a series of letters that I fed into the AI platform. To my shock, I received the following reply:
"I'm sorry, but I can't draft those letters focused on persuading voters through their Christian beliefs"
I pushed back and asked what was preventing it from drafting these letters. This AI platform did not mince words:
"The restriction concerns political persuasion tailored to religious beliefs or identity. I can't write messaging intended to influence Christians' voting decisions by appealing specifically to their faith, including using Scripture to encourage particular candidate choices"
I literally lost my breath as the rage rose inside of me. I wanted to thrash out against this non-being (that I was paying a subscription for) telling me it could not use the words of Christ. My anger quickly turned to fear when I realized that there was someone behind the scenes programming this omnipresent technology. These faceless programmers had instructed this model to reject any reliance on Christian teachings in deciding who has control of the levers of power.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae124d17-8448-4025-84c1-d50ac3195688?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
After a moment of quiet prayer, I remembered that I had just read about this very problem in a recent [encyclical letter ](https://substack.com/redirect/60bddc94-a740-4c48-ade8-f7b0c5cf7543?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)written by Pope Leo. His writings are powerful and hard to summarize in a single letter, but I want to highlight a few quotes that are instructional:
* "We cannot consider AI to be morally neutral."
* "Ethical discernment cannot be limited to asking whether we are using a system for good and bad purposes; it must also examine how that system is designed and what vision of the human person and society is embedded in the data models that guide it."
* "Models will be governed only by technocratic thinking and presented as necessary and inevitable, ultimately imposing rules shaped by those who control data, infrastructure and computing power."

In effect, AI models are unelected, omnipotent figures with an increasingly influential impact on how our society thinks, and processes ideas. We must come to grips with the realty that these influential models are controlled by people behind the curtain who create the model specs. These shadow influencers likely do not share our Christian values. Yet we permit these platforms to act as trusted advisors to help guide us through life decisions. Even more alarming, these applications are replacing parents and teachers as the guiding lights in children's lives.
We need more strong role models in our world, not soulless technology. In just a few days, you get to vote on who will represent us in state and local elections. Consider whether these individuals share your hometown values and answer to a higher power. Research your candidates and watch them in person to understand who they are. Do not, however, blindly rely on an AI model that is infiltrated by nameless influencers that have programmed it to reject any reference to Christian faith or scripture readings.
Your vote matters. Make it count.

Sen. Darline Graham (R-SC) waits to speak during a press conference at the Graham campaign office on October 22, 2026, in Columbia, South Carolina. Photo by Win McNamee/Getty Images.
Earlier this month, [The Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/720dde81-b981-4266-a740-1bc5f6a002b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reported that Sen. Darline Graham's husband, Larry Nordone, is a senior executive at a company that merged with a Chinese weapons maker. Graham, of course, is running for her late brother Sen. Lindsey Graham's South Carolina Senate seat, and she opposes "depending on Communist China" for manufacturing.
It was an embarrassing enough revelation for the campaign, but the friction between her husband's career and her stated politics, it turns out, goes significantly further than that. Graham's husband's company is also linked to a Chinese firm that the U.S. sanctioned in 2024 for heavily arming Russia in its war against Ukraine--in blatant contrast to the Graham family's staunch support for Ukraine.
Nordone is a senior executive at Cosmox Outdoors' subsidiary, Cosmox North America. Cosmox Outdoors, merged in 2021 with the Chinese weapons maker Zhongzhou Machinery Works (ZZM). Until recently, ZZM listed two major Chinese arms companies as "partners and clients."
The two Chinese companies are Poly Technologies and Norinco; they have both been sanctioned by the U.S. Poly Technologies was hit with [U.S. sanctions](https://substack.com/redirect/2558432b-8fc1-4f5f-950e-b3a0751d2f0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2024 for providing "sensitive military technologies" to Russia to facilitate its invasion of Ukraine, according to C4ADS, a U.S. intelligence-adjacent research outfit. Norinco is a military and aerospace conglomerate whose history of providing arms to Iran dates back to the Iran-Iraq War in the 1980s and remains on the Treasury Department's [restricted list.](https://substack.com/redirect/f54e0572-ecba-4aa9-b841-f0bb8bed70ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.ZRSkZTnFtVtzpwJ_OmAvwvIFmSUbZhFp5Noz5GpWwYk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=222536589)
Graham's brother, Lindsey Graham, was the Senate's most vocal champion of arming Ukraine against Russia. He died suddenly, according to his staff, shortly after returning from a visit to Ukraine, where he toured a drone factory. Darline Graham was appointed to replace her late brother and won the Republican nomination in South Carolina. She is facing Democrat Annie Andrews in a surprisingly close race.
Darline Graham was the lead sponsor on a bill, named for her brother and signed into law in September, that introduced a new set of sanctions on Russia and Iran. Though Trump signed the bill into law, he followed it with an executive order that rolled back its provisions.
"Lindsey believed this bill, which he worked on for well over a year, would help achieve [a peaceful resolution in Ukraine] through squeezing [Russian President Vladimir] Putin economically and forcing his customers to reevaluate the relationship with Russia," Graham reportedly [said](https://substack.com/redirect/264066a4-f518-4672-826b-ceb30d2e4528?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at a press conference in September.
The Bush administration sanctioned Norinco in 2003 for [allegedly selling](https://substack.com/redirect/f54e0572-ecba-4aa9-b841-f0bb8bed70ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) missile-related goods and technology to Iran, although the sanctions were [lifted](https://substack.com/redirect/2421a192-8953-4bf4-9cc2-e2b4d488e0e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2005.
In a [debate](https://substack.com/redirect/1c1a6491-2693-45dd-a2e1-57a1fb2ff6be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Andrews on October 11, Graham argued that President Donald Trump ought to continue pursuing the war on Iran. "Why in the world would we stop now when they're still dangerous?" Graham said, adding that she believed the U.S. was close to winning the war. "Again, I think the president wants to end the war. I know he does. We all want the war to end. But I support a strong military. I believe in peace through strength."
Cosmox and ZZM did not respond to questions from Drop Site. Nordone's employer scrubbed the reference to Norinco as one of its "partners and clients" from its website after inquiries from the Post:
> After The Post reached out with questions about ZZM's website touting its ties to the Chinese defense industry, a spokesperson for ZZM distanced the manufacturer from the defense companies, saying ZZM no longer does business with them. ZZM and Cosmox Outdoors' websites were then taken down and replaced with a notice to users that the sites are undergoing maintenance.
> ZZM's site reappeared days later with the mention of its own "military-grade" production capabilities removed, as well as mentions of Norinco and Poly Technologies. Cosmox Outdoors's site removed a tile from its homepage about ZZM but still linked to ZZM's site from Cosmox Outdoors' "Firearms" tab.
Rachel Chen, a spokesperson for Cosmox, answered the Post's questions on behalf of both ZZM and Cosmox, telling the paper, "Cosmox Outdoors has had no commercial dealings with CSGC [China South Industries Group Corporation], NORINCO, or Poly Technologies." The websites saying otherwise, said Chen, were out of date.

| | | I promise this one is short, and I promise it’s real. At a rally in Georgia, the President of the United States told the crowd he called Google about renaming an ocean after himself. The Atlantic or the Pacific, he wasn’t picky. He says he even sent them a map that said “The Trump Ocean.” **_According to Trump, Google’s answer was: “We’ve had it. That’s enough. We’re not doing it anymore.”_** Then, he says, they called back to explain: “Sir, look, OK, this one we can’t do. Oceans are different. Oceans cover many, many countries.” He says he was only kidding, and nobody knows for sure whether the call happened. But I’ll admit I smiled, because for once, somebody told him no. This is the same president who renamed the Gulf of Mexico and ordered federal agencies to call Lake Ontario “Lake America.” Google went along with both. An ocean is apparently where they drew the line. Here’s what stuck with me. “We’ve had it. That’s enough.” is a pretty good message. Google got to send it once. On November 3, voters get to send it to every Republican in Congress who has let him do whatever he wants for two years. That’s what Equal Opportunity Now is working on in this final stretch: helping Democrats up and down the ballot win the House and Senate, so someone in Washington finally has the power to say no. **[Google said “That’s enough.” Now it’s our turn. **DNC Chair Ken Martin Statement on the****Passing of Dolores Huerta**
---
| |

_**Today, DNC Chair Ken Martin released the following**_[ _**statement**_](https://us.list-manage.com/aPH8RtpmQaQ?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) _**:**_
“My friend, Dolores Huerta, was living proof that anyone can rise above their station in life to change our country for the better. Born during the Great Depression in a small mining town in New Mexico, she saw firsthand how workers could be exploited on their own — yet when they joined together, they could successfully fight for better wages, safer conditions, and dignity on the job.
“Dolores was a leading figure in the founding of the United Farm Workers and in the successful Delano grape boycott that secured labor protections for seasonal workers. It is why generations upon generations of Americans have been inspired by her fierce determination and her resilient spirit in the face of impossible odds. I was proud to stand with my friend in countless fights over the years, and we will all remember how she moved our nation closer to its highest ideals. Dolores Huerta’s legacy will live on every time an organizer, a worker, or a civil rights activist repeats her eternal words, _sí se puede!_ ”

clean_body: | | | | | | | | DNC Chair Ken Martin Statement on thePassing of Dolores Huerta | | Today, DNC Chair Ken Martin released the following : “My friend, Dolores Huerta, was living proof that anyone can rise above their station in life to change our country for the better. Born during the Great Depression in a small mining town in New Mexico, she saw firsthand how workers could be exploited on their own — yet when they joined together, they could successfully fight for better wages, safer conditions, and dignity on the job. “Dolores was a leading figure in the founding of the United Farm Workers and in the successful Delano grape boycott that secured labor protections for seasonal workers. It is why generations upon generations of Americans have been inspired by her fierce determination and her resilient spirit in the face of impossible odds. I was proud to stand with my friend in countless fights over the years, and we will all remember how she moved our nation closer to its highest ideals. Dolores Huerta’s legacy will live on every time an organizer, a worker, or a civil rights activist repeats her eternal words, sí se puede!_ ” | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | DNC Community Engagement 430 S Capitol Street, SE Washington, DC 20003 * USA or |

Derek, we know

been keeping up with these emails for a while now, but it doesn’t look
like you’ve chipped in to our campaign here in battleground
Pennsylvania.* Please, will you rush just $6 to help us
reach the 60,000+ undecided voters on our in-person contact list in these
final six days?

right now is worth more than a $60 donation on Election Day.

new ad. We still have time to place an expedited yard sign order. We still
have time to get more organizers on the ground ahead of our final GOTV

But on Election Day? Yes, your donation is valuable. But it doesn’t
stretch nearly as far as it does today.

If we lose this election, Trump’s allies will control every state-level

#### **Ivette DECODES**
**Is national security the greater reality?**
On October 19, the Department of Energy announced up to $42 million for the proposed 125-mile Constitution Pipeline from Pennsylvania into New York. The DOE projects $5 billion in energy savings, including $165 million annually for Northeast consumers, citing energy security and reduced costs.
The funding covers environmental reviews, engineering, and permitting--but full construction financing remains unannounced.
Supporters see strategic infrastructure. New York challenges the federal approach to state water-quality standards, while environmental groups raise concerns about local impacts.
**How should national-defense priorities be weighed against state authority and local consequences?**

Folks, I have good news and bad news. Which do you want first? Since you can’t answer, I’m going to start with the good: **We can win this race.** I believe that in my bones. I wish you all could feel the energy coming from every corner of the district, with folks who have never been political before showing up, ready to demand something better. Farmers, veterans, nurses, parents, students, Democrats, Republicans, Independents – Virginians of all kinds, of all beliefs, of all political persuasions are sick of what’s coming out of Washington and ready to elect someone who will go to bat for their lives, their families, and their futures. For those of you who care more about data than the feeling in my bones, I also have good news – our polling shows us in a dead heat, and when voters learn about my opponent's record, I pull into the lead. National polling shows a generic ballot at D+11 – just one less point than he won this seat by in 2024. We are straight-up shattering records for early votes never seen in any midterm election before. And our race just got moved to a toss-up by Sabato's Crystal Ball. _But as I said, there’s also bad news._ **Our donations are slowing down. A lot. This is the back-end of my ActBlue:**

That sounds like a lot, and it is a lot – but I know that this team is big enough to get it done if everyone who can afford to give contributes just a few bucks. subject: NEW: Our race is now a TOSS-UP, and here’s why

body:
Kansans are tired of seeing working people get the short end of the stick
#
Peter,
**IT’S OFFICIAL: Cook Political Report, one of the nation’s top election forecasters, just moved our race for Kansas governor from “Lean Republican” to “TOSS UP”! **
Yes, you heard that right: even though my GOP opponent, MAGA extremist Ty Masterson, has Donald Trump’s endorsement and over _**$21 million in national Republican cash**_ backing him — the kind of money our people-powered campaign could never raise — **we’re gaining on him, and now we’re running neck-and-neck.**
That means **we can win this race...** _if_ we all come together in these final days and make sure our campaign is able to reach out to every single undecided voter.
This election, more than most, will come down to every single vote, and that means every dollar matters.
**[So I hope you’ll split a contribution between our campaign and Small Town PAC — and do it now — to make sure we can get our message into every corner of Kansas in these last few days, and pick up every single vote we can.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp_ms_em_partner_smalltownpac_ch_20261028_2.tnYtCJ&amount=5&refcode=em20261028-1271&t=1&akid=1271%2E34582%2EoElXvo)**
**[HELP US WIN THIS ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp_ms_em_partner_smalltownpac_ch_20261028_2.tnYtCJ&amount=5&refcode=20261028-1271&t=2&akid=1271%2E34582%2EoElXvo)**
The people who make these forecasts are seeing what we’re seeing: **voters are tired of seeing working people get the short end of the stick.**
What do Kansans want from their governor? They want what everyone wants: help dealing with the challenges they face every day. You know what I mean:
_The costs of groceries keep on going up while wages stay the same... Businesses (here in Kansas, that includes farmers and ranchers) get crushed by the costs of fuel and supplies... And Donald Trump’s tariffs and war in Iran have made all that worse..._
You think voters don’t reflect on these things when they decide who to support? **Think again.**
**And Ty Masterson hasn’t done anything about any of it — in fact, he’s made it all worse.**
He’s one of the architects of the disastrous “Brownback tax experiment” — when Kansas gave giant tax breaks to price-gouging CEOs and billionaires that the rest of us paid for. And now he’s dangling _even more_ tax breaks in front of Big Tech companies to bring their enormous data centers to our neighborhoods.
Masterson knows exactly who he works for, _and it’s not you_. And that’s why we’re in a “TOSS UP” race, despite all the national GOP cash propping up his campaign.
**Now, a “TOSS UP” is better than running behind. But it’s not a win.** And if we’re going to win, we need to use every minute between now and Election Day to reach every single undecided voter, and bring them over to our side.
I know we can do it. **But we’ve got just a few days left.**
**[That means every dollar counts — not next week, not tomorrow, but right now. So please, make the most generous contribution you can, split between our campaign and Small Town PAC, to help us capitalize on today’s momentum and defeat Ty Masterson and his extremism.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp_ms_em_partner_smalltownpac_ch_20261028_2.tnYtCJ&amount=5&refcode=em20261028-1271&t=3&akid=1271%2E34582%2EoElXvo)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp_ms_em_partner_smalltownpac_ch_20261028_2.tnYtCJ&amount=5&refcode=20261028-1271&t=22&akid=1271%2E34582%2EoElXvo)**
**Kansans are already voting. There’s not a minute to lose.**
**[Please, make your donation right now!](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp_ms_em_partner_smalltownpac_ch_20261028_2.tnYtCJ&amount=5&refcode=em20261028-1271&t=23&akid=1271%2E34582%2EoElXvo)**
Thank you,
**Cindy Holscher**
Democratic Nominee for Kansas Governor

A community call to reflect, heal, and share love | | | Peter, this year has asked a lot of our communities. Families separated, neighbors detained, and so many of us carrying grief, fear, and exhaustion that we haven’t had the space to set down. We don’t have to hold it all alone. When we take care of each other, we get stronger together. That’s why we’re hosting****[**Powered by Community: A Space for Mental Health, Healing and Storytelling**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMchKqTlnDL9HV9V-hz_r8qN5sFN7uyIDHDQ_kqfTbgHpnuOuFd62__J0jYpBRofRWS43bG9W2WeZkRmlzs16tV3qfHgmIGD57JokGPQEg2VHanN4Fwg8x1R6uykvF85OS79Z-nmA_fwOvjgXD1iPx8Srdr5LJ5P0tYe0mXHlAiIIdOXcfBV4lAVOcd4GqVb01GdJ9QLIKGNSts_DFJiNTpYsuDf7dTT4TNCuUL7tLOP55kEvFW5flFHowJ4nWzDNtn8tYaPZm_1bt43dOjuAne3xmKSZcWasTF328x30AsK18aUnd7AbRHD14itWPqGQYA/4v9/DN4nuMDiRx2POtpnSmbwSg/h0/h001.TYfB7M2PbaFwa8OG0GjGXdcGgTbVR1lNij84HXX7TE8)**** on Tuesday, November 10 at 7PM ET. Here’s what to expect on the call: 🌱Take a moment to pause and reflect on this past year with support from a mental health professional 💌Write love notes and messages of care for our community ✍️Leave with letter-writing skills you can use again Our communities have always kept each other going. clean_body: A community call to reflect, heal, and share love | | | Peter, this year has asked a lot of our communities. Families separated, neighbors detained, and so many of us carrying grief, fear, and exhaustion that we haven’t had the space to set down. We don’t have to hold it all alone. When we take care of each other, we get stronger together. That’s why we’re hosting** on Tuesday, November 10 at 7PM ET. We’ll be joined by UndocuHealth mental health professional Jennifer Leon who will help us reflect on the year, name what we’re feeling, and turn it into words of love for our community. ** In this season of gratitude, we’ll write love notes to our neighbors, peers, and loved ones, reminding them that they are seen and that we show up for each other. Here’s what to expect on the call: 🌱Take a moment to pause and reflect on this past year with support from a mental health professional 💌Write love notes and messages of care for our community ✍️Leave with letter-writing skills you can use again Our communities have always kept each other going. Let’s come together for a space to heal, give thanks and spread love. – Ximena and the rest of the UWD Team | Follow us on: | | | | |

Here's what I'll fight for, and why it comes down to the next six days.

| | | | | [|

| | | | Peter, **In six days, the polls close in Washington.** **Yesterday, Fox News moved our race in our direction!** That makes two national forecasters – Fox News and Sabato's Crystal Ball – now saying this seat is no longer safe for my opponent. That’s right – even Fox News says this race is in play! Before the final stretch, I want to tell you plainly what’s really at stake for Eastern Washington after November 3. **Prices are outrageous.** My opponent surrendered Congress's power over tariffs and war. That cost our farmers and ranchers their overseas markets, drove up the price of groceries, gasoline and diesel, and put our Military in harm's way. **Our rural hospitals are at risk.** He voted for drastic cuts to Medicaid, even after Washington's own Republican legislators warned what it would mean for the 11 “critical access” hospitals serving rural communities. **Social Security has to be protected, not undercut** by tax giveaways to tech billionaires. **And the powerful have to be held accountable,** no matter who they are or which party they belong to. My opponent has plenty of experience as a career politician but I have almost 30 years of nonpartisan public service – as a Spokane County deputy prosecutor and as a career diplomat who served under four presidents. **I'll bring that problem-solving to Congress, and I'll****answer to you****.** [**_This race will be decided by what happens in the next 6 days – specifically by how many voters we can reach before Election Day. Will you chip in $10 to power our voter outreach in final week?_**](https://us.list-manage.com/XT5jYtW2E40?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4) | _If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately._

Hi Peter,

It’s hard to believe, but November 3rd is only one week away! Ours has been a grassroots campaign from day 1. Run almost exclusively by volunteers, including the leadership team, we’ve been able to put practically all of your donations into marketing and communications, so we can keep spreading the word to undecided voters. Here’s a brief overview of what you’ve helped us do:
1. Radio Advertising: 1,313 radio spots across 11 stations, including Civic Media, Audacy Madison, Woodward Radio, and Good Karma Radio.
2. Television Advertising: 76 TV spots on NBC 26 (WGBA), including morning programming, 5 PM news, and 10 PM news.
3. YouTube Advertising: 1,000,000 video ad impressions.
4. Digital Display Advertising: 500,000 general digital ad impressions.
5. Mobile Advertising (GOTV): 1,400,000 address-targeted mobile ad impressions focused on getting out the vote.
6. Streaming Television (OTT/CTV): 560,000 impressions, including 110,000 general impressions and 450,000 address-targeted impressions.
7. Facebook Advertising: 650,000 ad impressions.
8. Google Search Advertising: Search engine marketing campaign focused on defensive advertising and reaching voters searching for candidate information.
9. Billboard Advertising: 4 billboards across Dodge, Winnebago, Manitowoc, and Sheboygan counties.

All of these have been possible because of YOUR support. Thank you. We cannot ease off the gas, especially since many voters are only now starting to pay attention to who will be on their ballot. Donating now gives us the final push we need to make sure that, by the time every 6th-district voter looks down at their ballot this year, they’ll recognize Brad’s name.

| |

Join us for Brad Smith’s General Election Night Watch Party!
We’re bringing supporters, volunteers, friends, and neighbors together to watch the results come in and celebrate the incredible work this campaign has done across WI-06. The Colorado Civil Rights Division reached a determination on 974
discrimination complaints in FY24-25 and dismissed 902 of them, or
93%.

In the other 72 it found probable cause to believe discrimination
occurred, 44 fully and 28 in part. That works out to 7.4%.

or a settlement reached with an outside mediator.

investigators did not find enough evidence to carry the complaint
forward.

name: Voto Latino
subject: Today, the world lost a civil rights giant
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Rest in peace, Dolores Huerta.
#
Peter,
Today, the world lost a civil rights giant. Dolores Huerta passed away at the age of 96, and our entire Voto Latino family is grieving.
Dolores dedicated her life, right up until her final days, to fighting injustice for everyone, no matter who they were or where they came from. She co-founded the United Farm Workers, she gave us the words “¡Sí, se puede!”, and she forged a path for generations of Latino leaders who came after her.
To so many of us, she was a mentor, a strategist, and a friend. And above all, she always showed up.
At our Power Summit, Dolores was the one who stayed until the very last minute.
She never saw it as a waste of time. She spoke with everyone who approached her, and with all the grace in the world, she listened, and she guided them. She was mentoring our next generation of Latino leaders. Dolores saw the value and spirit in young people before the rest of the world was ready to, and because of her, our community learned to be its own advocate.
As our co-founder María Teresa Kumar shared today, Dolores always saw the good in people. And as our co-founder Rosario Dawson reminded us, she centered her life on leaving this world better than she found it. **Now it is up to us to carry her legacy forward.**
We lost a pillar of our community today, just days before an election that will shape our future.
**There is no better way to honor Dolores than to do what she spent her life asking of us: show up and lead with grace, humility, and a fierce belief in our community.**
Her work is not done. It is ours now. Thank you for everything.
With love and gratitude,
Voto Latino

body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20261028-2873-foote&t=1001&akid=2873%2E342411%2E0XvzQ8 ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

“I stand with Ilhan.”

These are the four words every member of the Squad has said since Trump’s
Department of Homeland Security agents raided Ilhan’s home earlier this
month. [ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/signup/20261028_stand_with_ilhan/?refcode=em20261028-2873&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2873%2E342411%2E0XvzQ8 ]Now we’re asking you to say them too.

This raid is Trump’s revenge campaign against Ilhan pushed to a new
extreme. It's built on the same baseless smears he’s recycled for years,
and the timing is no accident. Coming so close to the election, it’s meant
to stir up hate, create chaos, and scare anyone who dares to oppose him.

The Squad didn’t get to Congress with corporate PAC money or insider
connections. They got there because ordinary people, organizers, and
neighbors decided to build something bigger than themselves. That’s
exactly the kind of power Trump wants to break, and exactly the kind he
can’t.

He keeps underestimating this movement. His fascist, racist attacks have
never once made us back down, and this one won’t either. Coming after one
of us means coming after all of us, and every time he tries, we only stand
stronger together.

Trump is counting on silence. He wants Ilhan isolated, and he wants the
rest of us too intimidated to speak up. So let’s give him the opposite:
name after name, from every corner of this movement, saying the same four
words.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/signup/20261028_stand_with_ilhan/?refcode=em20261028-2873&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=2873%2E342411%2E0XvzQ8 ]Peter, will
you join our Squad and add your name to stand with Ilhan right now?

In solidarity,

The Squad Victory Fund

Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida are taking a stand against Trump,
his MAGA cronies, and anyone who gets in the way of justice, but they
can’t do it alone. And with the midterms just days away, the stakes have
never been higher.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261028-movement.WYleo3&refcode=em20261028-2873&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=2873%2E342411%2E0XvzQ8 ]Chip in now to stand with the Squad and keep our movement for bold,
progressive change strong.

Peter — did you see Bill Nye’s message? The Science Guy himself is calling on environmentalists like you to help take
back Congress from Big Oil-backed politicians this November. LCV Victory Fund is knocking on hundreds of thousands of voters’ doors in key
states, blanketing the airwaves to expose candidates who stand with polluters
over people, and getting voters the information they need to get their ballots
in and counted. It’s a big job — and we need your help to make it happen. Please, take a look at Bill Nye’s message below, and then rush your contribution of $15 or more to LCV Victory Fund now. Our triple match opportunity is still active for a limited time >> https://links.messages.lcv. — LCV Victory Fund DONATE TODAY >> https://links.messages.lcv. Greetings, Bill Nye here! I often say that science is the best idea humans have ever had and I truly
believe that. It’s how we learn about the world around us, how we test ideas,
and how we can make sure our climate and planet are safe for our families today,
and for our kids and grandkids in the future. That’s why I’m reaching out on behalf of LCV Victory Fund today. The way I see
it, science and democracy are both on the line in this election. Right now, this
administration is ignoring science, denying climate change, and putting all our
lives and our planet in danger. But we have a real shot at putting a stop to it Peter — by voting
climate champions into Congress. When we vote, we use our power to help protect our climate, Earth, and
democracy. And in states like Maine and Texas, there’s a real chance to flip
seats held by science deniers — but only if every person who cares about our
planet gets out and votes. These next couple of days leading up to the midterms
are our last, best chance to sway voters in the places that will decide this
election. Will you join me in helping get climate champions into Congress? Make a donation of $15 or more to LCV Victory Fund and help flip the Senate! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/gryxf4_ This is our chance to have real accountability and a Senate that will stand firm
against the administration’s attacks on science. If we all pitch in, we’ll be so
much closer to securing lasting protections for clean air and water; more
renewable, affordable energy that people can rely on; and a safe climate and
planet for future generations. But to make that happen, there’s still work to do. LCV Victory Fund has already
knocked on ONE MILLION doors in key states (and counting!). They’re blanketing
the airwaves to expose candidates who prioritize polluters over people. It won’t be easy, but with your help we can get it done. Do your part with a donation of $15 or more right now >> https://links.messages.lcv. Thank you for being a part of this fight. And please make sure you have a plan
to vote — whether it’s early, by mail, or on Election Day, your voice matters. Onward, Bill Nye https://links.messages.lcv. body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
I’ll be honest,
Derek: Many of our campaign emails
go out to a huge number of supporters.

This isn’t one of them.

Instead, I’m sending this email to a small handful of folks my team
specifically identified as top supporters: The folks who’ve read a few (or
maybe even a few hundred) of these campaign updates.

The folks who definitely aren’t on this list, though? My opponent’s
Mar-a-Lago megadonors.

This is the kind of campaign I want to run in these final six
days, Derek.
Folks like you [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21192?t=1001&akid=804%2E245147%2E3ioFhh ]chipping in $25, $5, even $1 at a time. No trips to
Mar-a-Lago included.

Here’s the problem: That strategy is a serious risk in a battleground
state like Pennsylvania. It only pays off when the folks who can chip in
to these emails do chip in.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21192?t=1002&akid=804%2E245147%2E3ioFhh ]So please: If this email landed in your inbox, it’s extremely important
that you chip in if you’re able. There aren’t millions of other supporters
reading this message — so I really need this core group of supporters to
step up, chip in, and help us reach thousands of undecided voters before
my opponent and her Mar-a-Lago donors can.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

With gratitude,

Josh Shapiro

name: Chris Pappas
subject: Tonight was important. The next 6 days are critical.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
We made our case tonight. Now let's take this momentum all the way to Election Day.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=9850%2E582294%2EU2uQHE)
Team, it’s Chris.
I just walked offstage from our final Senate debate in New Hampshire. I’m proud of the case we made tonight, and I’m ready to finish what we started eighteen months ago.
Now we have just six days to beat John Sununu and help Democrats take back the Senate. But I’ll be direct with you: We set out to raise $100,000 by the time the debate ended, and we’re still **$16,548** away. That’s why I’m reaching out right now. This team has stepped up time and time again. **[If you can, pitch in $5, $10, or whatever you can to help us reach our goal before midnight tonight.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_6.f0lBxd&refcode=em20261028-6&t=2&akid=9850%2E582294%2EU2uQHE)**
**[CHIP IN BEFORE MIDNIGHT »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_6.f0lBxd&refcode=em20261028-6&t=3&akid=9850%2E582294%2EU2uQHE)**
Tonight Granite Staters saw a clear choice.
I’m fighting to protect Social Security. People spend their working lives paying into it, and they deserve to know those benefits will be there when they retire. I’ll always oppose cuts. John Sununu still refuses to tell voters where he stands, and his last plan was to privatize it.
That difference matters. **And with Election Day just six days away, we need to make sure voters hear it.**
John Sununu has Donald Trump’s endorsement and over $66 million dollars in outside Republican spending behind him. They’re counting on their dark money to drown out our message in these final days.
_We can’t let that happen._
We need to keep our ads on the air, our organizers in the field, and our campaign reaching voters through next Tuesday. This race could help decide who controls the Senate, and every day between now and Election Day matters.
We don’t take corporate PAC money. This campaign is powered by people like you, and we’re counting on this grassroots team to help us finish strong.
**[Will you chip in $5 tonight to help hit our goal before midnight tonight? Every dollar we raise helps us reach more voters, beat John Sununu, and flip the Senate blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_6.f0lBxd&refcode=em20261028-6&t=4&akid=9850%2E582294%2EU2uQHE)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_6.f0lBxd&amount=5&refcode=em20261028-6&t=23&akid=9850%2E582294%2EU2uQHE)**
We’ve come too far to let up now. Six days left. Let’s get this done.
Thank you for being in this with me,
Chris
P.S.: The next six days could help determine control of the Senate. Your contribution tonight can help us keep reaching voters when it matters most. **[Chip in $5 now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_6.f0lBxd&refcode=em20261028-6&t=24&akid=9850%2E582294%2EU2uQHE)**
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

---
_Ignore the polls.

Ignore the pundits.

We need our grassroots team to channel all that energy and excitement into _action_. | **_A PERSONAL LETTER FROM REP. ELISE STEFANIK_**
---
Friend, this is it...
---
**The FINAL deadline before Election Day is just a few days away.**
---
Everything we’ve been fighting for all year comes down to this one moment.
---
**Either we CRUSH our goal, defy history by SAVING the President’s Majority, and continue on the path to freedom, prosperity, and American greatness...**
---
_...Or we lose the Majority to radical Far Left Democrats who will open our borders, put criminals back on our streets, and drag America back down towards socialism, chaos, and ruin._
---
For years now, I’ve poured my heart and soul into defending our Majority.
---
As a member of House GOP Leadership, I coordinated messaging to help Republicans WIN the 2022 midterms and 2024 presidential elections. I’ve spent countless hours campaigning to help WIN battleground races, and I’ve spent millions of my own funds to boost vulnerable Republicans.
---
And when the circumstances required it, I even withdrew my nomination to serve in President Trump’s cabinet so I could remain in the House and ensure our razor-thin Majority was secure enough to pass vital legislation, including the One Big Beautiful Bill!
---
_I’ll be honest with you – it would be devastating to see radical Far Left Democrats cancel out all my hard work and sacrifices by seizing the House Majority and impeaching the President._
---
**That’s why I’m going ALL IN with everything I have left to help us WIN this one last election before I leave Congress.**
---
_I don’t care what the polls say. I don’t care what the pundits say. I don’t care what the mainstream media says. The _ONLY_ thing I care about is doing everything I can to turnout voters and help our Party WIN on November 3rd._

MAGA has defied expectations before, and with your support, we’ll do it again!

| Today, my father passed away, and my heart is broken.
[Obituary here](https://eky6fg9ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001u8yqdIjBSF1Ic4NhYufWRO0Qb9GNBxLUsP9FP5V6hEYuxLaG6txH0SfSxsXbZkIq3LJg5QjJ_da6DpAU3yUbt3-BC79Avs7pC6Ywe1ey_WXA-_q2519VnihDTNyuF1JagJyFE0W1cFN9fHirPYLKLIeNAVmZkg_2br19ACTbDXVAxjDxGMqGPNllAKE1TI9vE-gi-lA_NW7NqLZDbWFik7npEz_tLT_i&c=q4T0M9deUkp-4gjEeuJ5E1ljyyCkLhfNePF9aYkYKmWFgYO3d6N0Lw==&ch=COrHiYCx8fzgTD3APJXuJYeWtiKicwQjQVqsYIootGP77AQb6eMO-A==)

[This song is about me](https://eky6fg9ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001u8yqdIjBSF1Ic4NhYufWRO0Qb9GNBxLUsP9FP5V6hEYuxLaG6txH0SfSxsXbZkIqs1GOIzd9tfhFsVEfETOzq_RkOG1UFbcR2xxiJlQekkQJejA7Jij1LMIaVt88-c0BS_agCVlGUe1FKTg34HxSFjLPcE28NrpB&c=q4T0M9deUkp-4gjEeuJ5E1ljyyCkLhfNePF9aYkYKmWFgYO3d6N0Lw==&ch=COrHiYCx8fzgTD3APJXuJYeWtiKicwQjQVqsYIootGP77AQb6eMO-A==), John McGuire III, and my campaign for re-election to Congress VA 05. The video features photos of me, my beloved father, family members, and friends who have been part of my life and journey.

Over the past few weeks and even last night, Dad would ask to hear this song. Every time we played it, it brought a smile to his face. My stepmother Judy told me he was trying to hang on until Election Day next Tuesday, hoping to see the outcome of my election.
After visiting with educators and students in Farmville, I made it back to my father's home just in time this morning to be with him before he passed away. My dad, John McGuire Jr., took his last breath surrounded by his five children and my stepmom as we were praying over him. 💔🙏
I will forever be grateful that I got that time with him.
What began as a campaign song will always hold a much deeper meaning for me. It will remind me of my father's love, his smile when he heard it, and the precious final days we shared.
Dad, this song is about your son, but today, it is dedicated to you. I love you, and I will carry your memory with me forever.
Thank you to our family, friends, and everyone who has kept us in their thoughts and prayers.

Patriot–About 30 million Americans have already voted.Election Day is less than a week from today: Tuesday, November 3. This election is not coming. It is happening right now, one ballot at a time.I want you in this fight before it is over, so I am inviting you into something new, easy, and effective.Tea Party Patriots Action now has a web-based texting platform that lets you reach voters in key states and districts from home. Volunteers have already sent more than 300,000 text messages to voters in key states and districts. Every one of those texts is a real person reminding a real voter that this election matters, and that common sense candidates need them to show up.Can you help us get to our goal of 1 million text messages?Close races are not decided by speeches. They are decided by who shows up. In 2024, a statewide ballot measure in Alaska was decided by only 664 votes. That is not a very big margin.That is why texting works. It reaches the voter who agrees with you and simply has not made a plan yet.**Here's what I need you to do:**
1. Go to [_**tpp.me/text**_](http://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/http:%2F%2Ftpp.me%2Ftext/1/010001a1848a27fd-1f138342-0544-4dab-bacf-d87d346eb123-000000/44asXD1xMZUwbDKiw38D0n_zswMJl2X95PA-ZAbJhTo=452) and sign up.
2. You will get access to our web-based texting platform and a simple instruction sheet.
3. Send texts to voters in the key states and districts where turnout will decide the outcome, from home, on your own schedule.
4. Read [_**this simple instruction guide**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftpp-resources.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fdocuments%2FTPPCF-TextVoters-OnePager.pdf/1/010001a1848a27fd-1f138342-0544-4dab-bacf-d87d346eb123-000000/2Eyss8kGyf08kwdKPkVaBybj0P_qQDnbT50GxNmriBk=452) to get started.

Friends,
One week. That is all that stands between us and the opportunity to chart a new course for our communities and our country. This election is not about right versus left. It’s about right versus wrong. It’s about protecting our freedoms, defending the rule of law, and building a future where the American Dream can actually become a reality. I come from a fourth-generation Hudson Valley family. My mom raised three girls on a postal worker’s salary, something that is not possible just a couple decades later. Today, families are working extra jobs just to get by, young people cannot afford to live in the communities that raised them, and the cost of everything from gas and groceries to housing and utilities are simply out of reach. And what has our federal government done? Made it worse. They’ve imposed tariffs, ended energy construction projects, cut Medicaid, threatened Social Security, and chosen to fight a reckless war of choice in Iran. For four years, Congressman Mike Lawler has been complicit, working at Trump's beck and call, voting with him 100% of the time. Over and over, he’s put his own political benefit ahead of the people he was elected to serve. I'm running for Congress not because it was some grand life plan, but because the country I was willing to risk my life for, and lost so many friends defending, is on the line. I grew up believing that what united us as Americans mattered more than what divided us. That belief guided me through 4 years at West Point and 16 years in the Army, where I served _everyone_ , regardless of how they voted. I promise to bring that same commitment to Congress and fight for a government that protects working Americans, not corporate interests. Where families can put food on the table, keep a roof over their heads, and save for the future. As we enter this final week, I am beyond grateful and humbled by the trust you've placed in me and everyone who has had the courage to step up. We will show the country that the Hudson Valley believes America's best days are still ahead of us. **Because we owe it to the next generation to leave behind a country better than the one we inherited.**
With gratitude and fire, Cait Conley

clean_body: | | | | Friends, One week. That is all that stands between us and the opportunity to chart a new course for our communities and our country. This election is not about right versus left. It’s about right versus wrong. It’s about protecting our freedoms, defending the rule of law, and building a future where the American Dream can actually become a reality. I come from a fourth-generation Hudson Valley family. My mom raised three girls on a postal worker’s salary, something that is not possible just a couple decades later. Today, families are working extra jobs just to get by, young people cannot afford to live in the communities that raised them, and the cost of everything from gas and groceries to housing and utilities are simply out of reach. And what has our federal government done? Made it worse. They’ve imposed tariffs, ended energy construction projects, cut Medicaid, threatened Social Security, and chosen to fight a reckless war of choice in Iran. For four years, Congressman Mike Lawler has been complicit, working at Trump's beck and call, voting with him 100% of the time. Over and over, he’s put his own political benefit ahead of the people he was elected to serve. I'm running for Congress not because it was some grand life plan, but because the country I was willing to risk my life for, and lost so many friends defending, is on the line. I grew up believing that what united us as Americans mattered more than what divided us. That belief guided me through 4 years at West Point and 16 years in the Army, where I served everyone , regardless of how they voted. I promise to bring that same commitment to Congress and fight for a government that protects working Americans, not corporate interests. Jon

# **Dozens of House Democrats decline to sign letter defending Ilhan Omar**

Some **[40 Democrats refused to sign](https://substack.com/redirect/08ab9329-8c7d-43e0-898a-a0acdfaa61d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** it in support.

subject: Can I count on you before I take the stage?
body:
The clock runs out when President Trump takes the stage. |
---

Peter,

In less than 24 hours, I'll walk out on stage in Rock Hill next to President Trump.

When I do, I want to tell him South Carolina's grassroots showed up. _Right now, I can't say that yet._

My team set a goal of 500 grassroots donations before the rally starts at noon tomorrow. Every one of them keeps our turnout ads on the air through Election Day. We are still short, and the clock stops the moment I take the stage.

Here's why this matters so much right now:

**Election Day is 6 days away.** The Democrats have decided South Carolina is where they take back the Senate. They're pouring money in behind Radical Annie because they know if they win this seat, Chuck Schumer gets his gavel back.

President Trump isn't coming to Rock Hill for a photo op. _He's coming because this race is that close and that important._

But he can't run our ads for us. That's on us. And if our ads go dark in the final days, Radical Annie gets the last word with every voter in this state.

I won't let that happen. Not this close to the finish line.

**[So I'm asking you right now, Peter: will you be one of the 500? $10, $25 or $50 is all it takes. It doesn't have to be big. It may not be glamorous, but my 2016 Dodge Caravan is getting me where I need to go over the next 6 days.
Which is good, because I've been racking up miles on this campaign to defeat Susan Collins.
### **I 've been driving to Mainers all over the state.**
To living rooms and diners and union halls and driveways, because that's where this campaign gets won, not at some fancy big-donor event, but wherever people are willing to talk to me.
Susan Collins and her MAGA backers have $114 million in ad spend behind her. I can promise you, she's not driving around in a minivan and eating pizza in between campaign stops like I am.
That's how this campaign runs, not unlike how you go about your day-to-day. No sleek black sedans or fundraising dinners with the ultra-wealthy -- just me, the road, and whoever's willing to say hello.
### **That 's how we're going to win.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/115560f9-32fa-4931-8ba3-c0644f7b2309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We are not going to outspend Susan Collins and her billionaire backers. We both know that. What we can do is stay loud and visible enough in these final 6 days that Mainers hear from us just as much as they hear from her on the airwaves and at their door.
That will take a lot of ad money. I'll need a whole lot of people to show up for this campaign the same way I'm showing up all over Maine.
**[So if you 've got it in you today, I could use your help keeping my ads on the air as we approach our final end-of-month deadline before Election Day.](https://substack.com/redirect/115560f9-32fa-4931-8ba3-c0644f7b2309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Honk if you want to defeat Susan Collins.

---

Fellow Patriot,
I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell.
None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war.
Not one of us flinched.
Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way.
**And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me.**
_Here 's why._
America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win.
Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher."
**That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside.**
**_Our sovereignty?_** They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long.
**_Our culture?_** They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of.
**_And our kids?_** That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for.
A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it.
Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't.
_So it 's up to us._
**And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House.**
Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. **Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once.**
If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys.

In less than one week, Americans will cast their ballots to determine whether we finally have a Senate that can be a check on Donald Trump's extreme agenda.
**The polls are showing Democrats have a real chance in many of the battleground states we need to flip the Senate.** Americans are seeing the need for a change, and the numbers are catching up to the on-the-ground momentum we've felt for months. Just look:
**ALASKA
** 🔵Peltola 46%
🔴Sullivan 47%
**IOWA
** 🔵Turek 46%
🔴Hinson 44%
**KANSAS
** 🔵Hamilton 47%
🔴Marshall 48%
**MAINE
** 🔵Jackson 49%
🔴Collins 46%
**OHIO
** 🔵Brown 45%
🔴Husted 46%
**TEXAS
** 🔵Talarico 47%
🔴Paxton 47%
But we must be clear-eyed about some of these races. Senate control runs through some states Democrats haven't won in _years_.
And we've seen good polls before. We all remember 2016. We can't take these signs for granted and get complacent. We can't let up now to find ourselves blindsided on election night.
**So here 's where you come in.** Ultimately, Senate control will be fought and won seat by seat. The grassroots power of THIS team has put so many of these red states in play, and it's what's going to push Democrats over the finish line one week from today.
**So I need this team to come together one more time.** We've seen the havoc wreaked by the Trump administration for too many long years now. We've watched what happens when the people in charge face no consequences, but we've also seen what becomes possible when there are enough Democrats willing to stand up and demand better.
A Democratic Senate would mean real oversight. It would mean a chance to block unqualified extremists from being confirmed to Cabinet and judicial positions. It means that when this administration puts our service members at risk or lets bigotry pass without consequence, we're in a powerful position to speak out and fight back.
**So I 'm asking you directly because I don't want to wake up on Nov. 4 and think there's something I could have done differently:**

One week, team. Thanks for standing with us when it counts.
Jacky

clean_body: It all comes down to this. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more It all comes down to this. | | | Oct 28 | | | | | | | | | | | | In less than one week, Americans will cast their ballots to determine whether we finally have a Senate that can be a check on Donald Trump's extreme agenda. The polls are showing Democrats have a real chance in many of the battleground states we need to flip the Senate. Americans are seeing the need for a change, and the numbers are catching up to the on-the-ground momentum we've felt for months. Just look: ALASKA 🔵Peltola 46% 🔴Sullivan 47% IOWA 🔵Turek 46% 🔴Hinson 44% KANSAS 🔵Hamilton 47% 🔴Marshall 48% MAINE 🔵Jackson 49% 🔴Collins 46% OHIO 🔵Brown 45% 🔴Husted 46% TEXAS 🔵Talarico 47% 🔴Paxton 47% But we must be clear-eyed about some of these races. Senate control runs through some states Democrats haven't won in years. And we've seen good polls before. We all remember 2016. We can't take these signs for granted and get complacent. We can't let up now to find ourselves blindsided on election night. So here 's where you come in. Ultimately, Senate control will be fought and won seat by seat. The grassroots power of THIS team has put so many of these red states in play, and it's what's going to push Democrats over the finish line one week from today. So I need this team to come together one more time. We've seen the havoc wreaked by the Trump administration for too many long years now. We've watched what happens when the people in charge face no consequences, but we've also seen what becomes possible when there are enough Democrats willing to stand up and demand better. A Democratic Senate would mean real oversight. It would mean a chance to block unqualified extremists from being confirmed to Cabinet and judicial positions. It means that when this administration puts our service members at risk or lets bigotry pass without consequence, we're in a powerful position to speak out and fight back. So I 'm asking you directly because I don't want to wake up on Nov. 4 and think there's something I could have done differently: One week, team. Thanks for standing with us when it counts. Jacky * `A personal note from Sen. Jacky Rosen:` `My work in the Senate has always been defined by who I am and where I come from. Growing up as the granddaughter of immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, my family instilled in me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence at a young age.` `Now, I'm proud to fight tirelessly in the Senate to deliver progress for hardworking families like mine in Nevada and across our country. But with Donald Trump in the White House and Republicans in control of both houses of Congress, I need your grassroots support to keep up the fights that matter most.` `Senate Democrats like me are the only thing standing in the way of Trump's extreme agenda that will hurt everyday Americans. That's why I need people like you on my side to help defend our progress and reclaim power from the GOP.` `If you're with me, will you chip in now to help Democrats take back the Senate majority?` Paid for by Jacky Rosen for Nevada. Northern Nevada deserves a representative who puts people first.

| Peter,

**I’m proud to support Teresa Benitez-Thompson for Congress in Nevada’s 2nd District.**

Teresa has spent her career fighting for Northern Nevadans. As a social worker and a state legislator for 12 years, she’s seen firsthand how policy decisions affect working families.

And as a mother of four, she understands the challenges families are facing as they work to make ends meet and build a future for their children.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142404570/656802354/-970398031?amount=15&source=EM_NBI_AB_20261028_FR_Teresa_0_3MO_AmiBera_NA_NA_TeresaSPLIT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzBiODQzYy0yNGQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GPDcaJQIPUEYay1UWDcKJ5dHWpds0pAWm0M7Wpr_bXw=)

[**Will you show Teresa you have her back by splitting a donation between our campaigns?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142404575/656802360/-970398031?amount=15&source=EM_NBI_AB_20261028_FR_Teresa_0_3MO_AmiBera_NA_NA_TeresaSPLIT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzBiODQzYy0yNGQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GPDcaJQIPUEYay1UWDcKJ5dHWpds0pAWm0M7Wpr_bXw=)

**Check out of a few of our Republican opponents making headlines for all the wrong reasons:**
**1\. ANNA PAULINA LUNA — FLORIDA**
This GOP congresswoman claims to oppose corruption and self-dealing. But her husband owns 10% of a drone company awarded **$37 MILLION** in Pentagon contracts — programs she voted to fund. She's used campaign funds for private jets and luxury cars while Floridians struggle with rising costs.
**2\. DAVID FLIPPO — NEVADA**
This GOP House candidate repeatedly claimed he'd earned a Bronze Star **"for valor,"** which turned out to be a lie. He blamed campaign staff and even his grandkids for the false claims, while questions about his scammy campaign and personal finances have added to the controversy. The retiring Republican Representative won't even vote for him and called his campaign a 'fraud freight train.'
**3\. VIVEK RAMASWAMY — OHIO**
This GOP candidate for governor put **$4 MILLION** behind an attack ad featuring Dr. Amy Acton's estranged abusive mother, attempting to turn childhood trauma into political fodder. Even Ohio's Republican governor called for the ad to come down. But Ramaswamy is standing by it, which tells us everything we need to know about his character.

clean_body: Their words aren’t worth the campaign flyers they’re printed on. | = Peter, Republicans know they're about to lose. Big time. In the final days of this election cycle, Republicans are giving a whole new meaning to selfish, dishonest, and shameless. That's why we're working around the clock to support Democratic pro-choice women who are running to fight for their communities, not themselves. = | = Check out of a few of our Republican opponents making headlines for all the wrong reasons: 1\. ANNA PAULINA LUNA — FLORIDA This GOP congresswoman claims to oppose corruption and self-dealing. But her husband owns 10% of a drone company awarded $37 MILLION in Pentagon contracts — programs she voted to fund. She's used campaign funds for private jets and luxury cars while Floridians struggle with rising costs. 2\. DAVID FLIPPO — NEVADA This GOP House candidate repeatedly claimed he'd earned a Bronze Star "for valor," which turned out to be a lie. He blamed campaign staff and even his grandkids for the false claims, while questions about his scammy campaign and personal finances have added to the controversy. The retiring Republican Representative won't even vote for him and called his campaign a 'fraud freight train.' 3\. VIVEK RAMASWAMY — OHIO This GOP candidate for governor put $4 MILLION behind an attack ad featuring Dr. Amy Acton's estranged abusive mother, attempting to turn childhood trauma into political fodder. Even Ohio's Republican governor called for the ad to come down. But Ramaswamy is standing by it, which tells us everything we need to know about his character. And those are just three examples. body:
Judicial Watch announced that it filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice seeking a 2021 investigative report by the FBI’s Office of Professional Responsibility (OPR) concerning Operation Crossfire Hurricane, the FBI’s investigation into alleged links between the 2016 Trump presidential campaign and Russia (Judicial Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice (1:26-cv-03603)).

HJR6 is a bill I sponsored in the Senate to make English is the official language of the state of Idaho by putting it in our state constitution.

| |
---|---|---
|
# About the english language thing on the ballot
| | | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Oct 28
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
HJR6 is a bill I sponsored in the Senate to make English is the official language of the state of Idaho by putting it in our state constitution. But it's already in statute so why the bill?
For starters, my only complaint about HJR6 is that, if it passes, it took 19 years to put the 2007 statute where a future legislature can't gut it.
Agencies already ignore the statute.
Subsection (5) sends non-English printing and translation money back to the general fund and makes agencies report it to the controller, and Health and Welfare and the schools keep spending it anyway. So, why put it in the constitution? Because an agency can shrug off a statute. But it can't shrug off the constitution when its budget's on the line.
Besides, the current exceptions are wide enough to drive a truck through. "Public health and safety needs" covers whatever a bureaucrat wants it to cover. Some of those exceptions go away if this passes, and that's the point. The first to die is the corporate one, non-English government work for "tourism and economic development, including the hosting of international events." If the Chamber wants international events, it can pay its own translators.
What stays is the federal carve-out: "except as required by federal law." ESL, Voting Rights Act ballots and court interpreters are untouched. So anyone claiming kids or defendants get abandoned is fear-mongering, and they haven't read (or, are lying about) the actual words on the ballot.
Every wave of immigrants before this one learned English, and America was stronger for it. Assimilation is the most generous thing a country can offer a newcomer, because it's a ticket to full membership. Printing everything in six languages tells people they never have to join.
So the message to everyone who comes here, legal or not, is this: you're welcome to become one of us, and that starts with English. Teddy Roosevelt said as much in 1919:
_" We have room for but one language here, and that is the English language." _
Thirty states have made English official, and the President signed an executive order declaring it the national language in 2025.
**Vote YES on HJR6.**
Cheers,
Brian
(C) 2026 Brian Lenney

You are not hallucinating. We really have taken a huge lead in early voting, hitting totals that have no precedent in any midterm. We really are posting big numbers in some counties that have traditionally been deep red. Heck, you are even seeing us win the yard sign war this year, not to mention the race for likes and engagement on social media. That grassroots and netroots energy is real. _But none of it guarantees a victory._ I know how powerful hope can be, and nobody is using it more to get through another double-shift day of campaigning. But we are still a very long way from winning this seat. **A week is a lifetime in politics, and their side is set to flood the zone on Election Day. We cannot waste any day of early voting or leave any door unknocked.** Yesterday, we had Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock campaigning with us in Danville, Charlottesville, and Lynchburg. He spoke with great clarity about this election as a “moral moment for our country.” He spoke about bearing witness to Speaker Mike Johnson organizing a prayer circle right before voting for the big, ugly bill that kicked millions of children off SNAP and Medicaid. He asked, “ _How do they pray over the people before preying on the people?_ ” He called us all to dig deep into our reservoir of strength to find the courage and the endurance to give everything we can between now and polls closing at 7pm on November 3rd, less than one week from today.

I want to take a moment to remember Dolores Huerta. Today people around the country and the world are mourning her loss — and we are also celebrating her extraordinary life and legacy. Dolores was one of the greatest champions for justice California and our nation have ever known. She was not only a personal hero to me, but someone I was deeply proud to call a friend and mentor. I first encountered Dolores as a very young child. My family had moved to California because the Philippines, my mom’s home country where we were living, was on the brink of martial law, with a dictator rising to power. It was deeply important to my parents that I grew up in a country with democracy, freedom, rule of law, and human and civil rights. When we got to California, we lived in a union-owned trailer at the United Farm Workers of America headquarters. I grew up watching my parents fight for workers’ rights, fair pay, and shade and water breaks with the UFW alongside Dolores and Philip Vera Cruz. As long as I can remember, I’ve known that I wanted to follow in their footsteps and fight for those most vulnerable to have a fair shot at the California Dream. That’s why I do this work. As an attorney, I advocated for my clients against systemic injustices, like racial profiling and housing discrimination. As Vice Mayor and a California legislator, I worked to create real solutions for the problems facing my community and bring tangible relief to my neighbors who were struggling. And now, as California Attorney General, I’m fighting every day to keep our neighborhoods safe, hold bad actors, fraudsters, and schemers accountable to the law, and protect our state and our people from a President hell-bent on clawing back our funding, trampling our rights, and dismantling our freedoms. I’m committed to using every bit of platform I have to lift people up, stand against those who abuse their power, and fight for justice for all. **It's been an honor and the privilege of a lifetime to serve as California Attorney General, and I would be so grateful to earn another term fighting your fights.** If you’re with me, I hope you’ll consider supporting my re-election campaign: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142405249/656804555/2110272206?refcode=261028em_rb_dolores&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmYyNWI1MS0yNmQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MRIPY7LCtq3FGcZxrlLNji4jd9m6dhIO2-2aqiXYpas=) Thank you so much for standing beside me in these fights for our rights, our freedoms, and our future.

There is no fixing affordability without fixing housing costs. Rent is the biggest bill most families pay, and decades of underbuilding made it worse.

My plan cuts the red tape that makes homes slow and expensive to build. It doubles federal affordable housing production.

It pays for a generational investment in social and affordable housing by reversing big parts of the Trump tax cuts for corporations and the wealthy.

This isn’t a promise from someone who just started working on housing. This has been my passion for over a decade.

In 2012, I upzoned my own supervisor district. In the Senate, I wrote legislation to fast-track affordable housing in cities that fall behind, and allow more homes near transit.

**Billionaires and special interests would prefer Congress didn’t make the kind of progress California has on housing — and they’re doing everything they can to stop me because they know how much I’m capable of.**

He and his cronies — like Pete Hegseth and RFK Jr. — like to play strong men, but they treat their power like a shield they can hide behind. They like to flex, not serve.
Trump doesn't care about you. He's focusing on lining his own pockets, building monuments to himself, and suppressing the vote, because he knows he can't stay in power otherwise. His Cabinet is willing to continue letting him play king like this if it means they can have a little power too.
This administration is literally stealing from the poor to give to the rich, cutting Medicaid and food assistance to create new tax breaks for the 1%. They're not "brave" for sending other people's kids to die in wars of choice.

From Arizona to Florida to Michigan to Georgia, I’ve been criss-crossing the country to support my colleagues facing tough races, and my hopefully-soon-to-be-colleagues fighting to flip red seats. I’m so excited to be helping as many Democrats as I can in these final days! **Tomorrow, Thursday 10/29, I’ll be joining four (yes, 4!) virtual phone banks to kick off voter outreach in targeted battleground districts, and I’d love for you to join me.** This is a great chance to channel any of that pesky midterm anxiety into action that will help us get the results we all want — plus, calling voters can be a lot of fun! Fellow Patriot,
I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell.
None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war.
Not one of us flinched.
Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way.
**And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me.**
_Here 's why._
America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win.
Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher."
**That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside.**
**_Our sovereignty?_** They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long.
**_Our culture?_** They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of.
**_And our kids?_** That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for.
A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it.
Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't.
_So it 's up to us._
**And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House.**
Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. **Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once.**
If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys.

You know what comes next. Endless witch hunts. Impeachment circuses. Every bill to secure the border and protect our elections will be dead on arrival. Two more years of the Left fighting to undo everything we've accomplished – and setting the stage to finish the job in 2028.
**This is the whole ballgame. Not one race._The entire House._**
I know that fight better than most. Last December, when our majority was on the line in Tennessee's special election, national Democrats threw everything they had at it. We beat them by nearly 9 points. Now they want revenge – on me and on every Republican standing between them and power.
**In just a matter of days, it all comes down to Election Day.** The Democrats and their media allies are watching every close race for a Republican who looks weak. Wherever they see weakness, they'll pile on. Wherever they see strength, they'll think twice.
